# AirQuality Data Analysis using Pandas

## Project Overview
This project analyzes the AirQuality dataset using Python and pandas. The dataset contains daily air pollution and weather information.

## Tools Used
- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Jupyter Notebook
- Pydataset

## Tasks Performed
- Checked dataset shape, data types, and sample records
- Generated summary statistics
- Identified and handled missing values
- Selected and filtered rows and columns
- Sorted data by multiple columns
- Checked duplicate records
- Created derived columns and categories
- Used group-by and aggregation functions

## Key Learning
I learned how to clean, filter, sort, and summarize data using pandas. I also practiced handling missing values and using group-by analysis.

## Conclusion
This assignment improved my data analysis skills in Python. I learned how to explore air-quality data and identify relationships between pollution and weather conditions.
